notes: One prompt, 19 minutes, first clean landing run for Lovable. Three treatments with euro prices, a real contact form, an about section and a footer with the address. Content quality is the weak point: the photographs come from picsum, so the hero shows a forest and the About portrait is not a therapist. No horizontal scroll at 320, 390 or 430 px, no console errors.
